_comment: Workflow routing SSOT for dhpk. Used by userpromptsubmit-skill-hint.sh (advisory hint) and by /dhpk:do Smart Router. Patterns are ERE (extended regex). First match wins. Add specific patterns before general ones. Each intent is ONE rule whose pattern ORs the English and Chinese forms together (`<en>|<zh>`) — retune both languages in a single place. precommit is ordered before smart-commit so 'precommit' / '提交前檢查' are not swallowed by the broad 'commit' / '提交' match.
_design_note: This fast path is deliberately HIGH-PRECISION, not high-recall (issue #84). Long multi-part / compound analysis requests — especially Chinese asks that mix several intents (e.g. fetch+compare+verify+fix) — are EXPECTED to return NO_MATCH and fall through to /dhpk:do's LLM classification, which is the correct tool for genuinely ambiguous compound intent. Do NOT loosen the `.{0,N}` proximity windows or add broad standalone CJK verb keywords to chase recall: this table is shared with the advisory skill-hint surface, so a mis-route here is a regression on both surfaces. The scan cost is negligible (~20ms, python startup dominated — measured 2026-07-23), so a length-based fast-fail is not worth the regression it causes (it would flip currently-matching long queries — e.g. a long preamble ending in 'bug' — to NO_MATCH). Add a CJK pattern only for an UNAMBIGUOUS single-intent phrase, anchored tightly enough not to fire on compound queries.

rules.pattern: (unattended|auto[- ]?run|goal +session|overnight|hands?[- ]?off).{0,30}(implement|change|openspec|opsx|session|run)|(無人值守|自動跑完|過夜跑|掛著跑).{0,20}(實作|變更|openspec|opsx)?
rules.label: unattended OpenSpec goal session

rules.pattern: fix\s+(mypy|ruff|pytest(-asyncio)?)|(修復|修正).{0,8}(mypy|ruff|pytest(-asyncio)?)
rules.label: adaptive dev workflow (python build)

rules.pattern: fix\s+(cargo|rust)\s+(build|compile|error)|(修復|修正).{0,8}(cargo|rust).{0,8}(建置|編譯|錯誤)
rules.label: adaptive dev workflow (rust build)

rules.pattern: (^|[^a-z])(bug|bugfix|crash|broken|stack[ -]?trace|exception|failure|fail(s|ed|ing)?|error[ -]?out|regress(ion|ed)?)([^a-z]|$)|修.{0,8}(bug|錯誤|問題|缺陷|異常)
rules.label: adaptive dev workflow (bug)

rules.pattern: (code +review|review +(this|the|my)? *(diff|change|patch|pr|code)|quality +check|lint +everything|(程式碼|代碼)\s*(審查|review)|(審查|review)\s*.{0,6}(diff|變更|差異|patch|pr|程式碼|代碼))
rules.label: manual code review

rules.pattern: (security +(scan|audit|review)|owasp|injection|xss|csrf|auth +bypass)|(安全|資安).{0,8}(掃描|稽核|審查|檢查)
rules.label: security review

rules.pattern: (explore|trace|how +does|walk +through|map +the|understand +the).{0,40}(code|flow|module|architecture)|(探索|追蹤|理解|釐清).{0,12}(程式|代碼|流程|架構|呼叫|實作)
rules.label: code exploration

rules.pattern: (audit|inventory|health|stocktake).{0,40}(project|repo|codebase|harness|skill|agent)|(健診|健康檢查|體檢|盤點).{0,12}(專案|代碼|harness|skill|agent)

rules.pattern: (deploy(ment|ing)?|publish|release|ship).{0,40}(list|manifest|files|plan)|(部署|發版|釋出|上版).{0,12}(清單|manifest|計劃)
rules.label: deploy list

rules.pattern: (refactor(ing)?|simplify|clean[ -]?up|dedup(licate)?|tidy +up|(remove|delete|strip|eliminate) +dead[ -]?code)|(重構|簡化|清理|去重)

rules.pattern: (mine|extract|reverse[- ]?engineer|harvest|bootstrap).{0,24}spec(s|ification)?|(萃取|挖掘|逆向|提取).{0,8}規格

rules.pattern: (tech(nical)? +spec|requirements +doc|design +doc|architecture +doc)|(技術規格|需求文件|設計文件|架構文件|tech spec)
rules.label: tech spec authoring

rules.pattern: (precommit|pre[- ]commit|pre +push)|(pre.?commit|提交前|commit 前).{0,8}(檢查|驗證)
rules.label: pre-commit checks

rules.pattern: (create(?!-)|open|draft)\b.{0,20}\b(pr|pull +request|merge +request)\b|(建立?|開|發|draft).{0,8}(pr|pull request|合併請求)
rules.label: create PR

rules.pattern: (create|cut|start|run|perform|do).{0,20}release|(發布?|切|跑|執行).{0,12}(新版本|release|發版流程)
rules.label: create release

rules.pattern: (smart +)?commit|stage +(and +)?commit|(提交|暫存).{0,8}(修改|變更|差異)?
rules.label: smart commit

rules.pattern: (feasibility|first +principles|estimate +effort|estimate +scope)|(可行性|工時評估|範圍估算)
rules.label: feasibility study

rules.pattern: (risk +(assess|analysis|audit)|blast +radius|impact +analysis)|(風險|影響範圍|blast radius).{0,8}(評估|分析)

rules.pattern: (playwright|write.{0,20}e2e[ -]?(test|spec|suite)|author.{0,20}e2e|e2e[ -]?(journey|flow|test|spec))|(playwright|寫.{0,8}e2e|補.{0,8}e2e|端對端.{0,8}(測試|test))

rules.pattern: ((unit|integration)[ -]?(test|tests|testing|coverage|gap|gaps)|(unit[ /-]integration|integration[ /-]unit)(.{0,20}(test|tests|testing|coverage|gap|gaps))?)|((單元|整合).{0,8}(測試|test|覆蓋率|缺口)|(測試|test).{0,8}(單元|整合))

rules.pattern: (new|add(ing)?|implement(ing)?|build(ing)?|create) +.{0,40}(feature|endpoint|page|action|module|api)|(新增|加上?|寫個?|新做|實作).{0,12}(功能|特性|feature|頁面|端點|api)
rules.label: adaptive dev workflow (feature)

rules.pattern: (verify|verification|run +all +tests?|full +test +run|run +tests?|validate\s+(artifact|skill|agent|command))|(跑.{0,8}測試|執行.{0,8}測試|跑 phpunit)
rules.label: verification loop
